subject.title: fix(google): use stable Gemini image model

question: Should this PR adopt the dedicated OpenRouter Images API implementation from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97505, or should its OpenRouter changes be split out so one PR owns that provider route?
rationale: Both branches affect the same stable OpenRouter image IDs but propose different runtime ownership and request behavior; selecting the permanent provider path requires maintainer intent beyond a mechanical correction.

options.title: Adopt the dedicated Images API path
options.body: Repair the Pro migration and rework this PR’s OpenRouter provider change to use the dedicated Images API with focused request and response coverage.

options.title: Split the OpenRouter changes
options.body: Keep this PR focused on Google defaults and safe doctor migration, while the related PR owns OpenRouter endpoint routing and catalog expansion.

options.title: Pause both OpenRouter paths
options.body: Defer stable OpenRouter default changes until maintainers choose the supported compatibility and endpoint policy.

recommendation.title: Adopt the dedicated Images API path
recommendation.body: Repair the Pro migration and rework this PR’s OpenRouter provider change to use the dedicated Images API with focused request and response coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The adjacent PR supplies the concrete dedicated OpenRouter image API implementation that overlaps the unresolved routing decision.
